sentences.l2: 咖啡豆成熟后，人们把它们摘下来。
sentences.l1: After the coffee beans ripen, people pick them.

sentences.l2: 一些国家卖咖啡豆，这是出口。
sentences.l1: Some countries sell coffee beans; this is export.

sentences.l2: 一些国家买咖啡豆，这是进口。
sentences.l1: Some countries buy coffee beans; this is import.
The coffee beans are sent to factories.

sentences.l2: 工厂把咖啡豆做成饮料。
sentences.l1: Factories make the coffee beans into a drink.
Many people like to drink coffee.
They drink coffee; this is consumption.

sentences.l2: 农业帮助我们得到咖啡豆。
sentences.l1: Agriculture helps us get coffee beans.
